messages.content: How many calories are in a tomato?

message.content:
A typical medium tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 calories**.  
If you’re looking at different sizes:

| Size (approx.) | Weight | Calories |
|----------------|--------|----------|
| Small (≈90 g)  | 90 g   | ~15 cal |
| Medium (≈123 g)| 123 g  | ~22 cal |
| Large (≈182 g) | 182 g  | ~33 cal |

These values are averages; actual calories can vary slightly depending on variety and ripeness. Tomatoes are very low‑calorie, high‑water foods, making them a great addition to salads, sauces, or any dish.

But we might want to provide a range. The user didn't specify size. We can give typical values. Also we can mention that it's low-calorie. No function call needed.
